features.title: QR type picker
features.summary: qr-codes-type lists website, v-card, gallery, menu, event, feedback, loyalty, content.
features.content:
## QrCodesTypeComponent

Entry surface at `/qr-codes/type`. Each tile navigates to `/qr-codes/type/{type}` for the correct wizard pair.

features.title: Website QR wizard
features.summary: website-step-one and website-step-two capture URL and styling.
features.content:
## Routes

`/qr-codes/type/website` → customize → `/qr-codes/edit/website/:id` mirrors the same components with loaded state from GetQR.

features.title: Menu QR wizard
features.summary: Menu flows hook into shops/content configuration before viewer.
features.content:
## menu-step-one / menu-step-two

Collects branding, sections, and links to shop-backed catalog where enabled. Final payload is JSON in `ContentJson` for SmartQRApi.

features.title: Loyalty program wizard
features.summary: loyalty-step-one and loyalty-step-two define program rules and visuals.
features.content:
## Loyalty

After publish, registration and stamp APIs apply. See **Smart QR — Loyalty** domain.

features.title: Content system wizard
features.summary: Hero, sections, parking, promotions tabs map into content QR JSON.
features.content:
## content-step-one / two

Reuses shared content-* tab components under `shared/` for consistent layout editing.

features.title: V-card, gallery, event, feedback
features.summary: Each type follows the same step-one / step-two pattern with type-specific fields.
features.content:
## Pattern

1. Collect base metadata and media. 2. Customize appearance. 3. Save via `saveQRCodeToBackend` → `SaveQR`.

features.title: QRTypeID mapping
features.summary: getQRTypeID and mapQRTypeIdToType bridge API integers to string union types.
features.content:
## qr-code.service

When sending to API, string types like `loyalty-program` convert to numeric `QRTypeID`. Keep mapping updated when backend adds types.

features.title: Pending QR after signup
features.summary: login-v2 saves queued QR via qrCodeService after Register success.
features.content:
## Flow

If user designed a QR before account exists, data is held client-side then `saveQRCodeToBackend` runs once `userId` and `licenseId` exist.
